Same driver and same operations as the MCP provider with a different transport: an npm native addon loaded into the host process. A Go binary cannot load it and desktop drivers never run inside the host, so it is folded into the external Cua Driver provider.

The bundle is a static patch that adds four rows and selects a default recogniser. In Go a bundle is a named set of entries embedded in the binary; the speech and voice-input components are default-off entries of the experimental bundle and no default provider is selected.

justification: Kept on purpose by DH-ADR-XCUA-5: dictation inserts editable text into the draft and nothing else. A transcript history would store speech the user never sent, and streaming needs partial-result revision that complete-recording dictation does not.

Kept: providers selected by exact id with no fallback, so a local failure can never upload speech; recordings and transcripts transient until the user submits ordinary text; no turn and no session event; insertion only against an unchanged draft; nothing heavy allocated by enabling the feature.
